Leisure Suit Larry - Magna Cum Laude.name: Leisure Suit Larry: Magna Cum Laude
Leisure Suit Larry - Magna Cum Laude.summary: Leisure Suit Larry: Magna Cum Laude is a 2004 video game, part of the Leisure Suit Larry series. The game introduces a new main character, 'Larry Lovage', as Larry Laffer's nephew. This is the 7th game in the series.

NBA Live 06.name: NBA Live 06
NBA Live 06.summary: NBA Live 06 is the first game in the franchise to reach next generation consoles.
